# Create Beam Effect

Source: [wiki article 4340](../archive/4340.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Create Beam Effect](../../api/actions/create-beam-effect.md).

<a id="wiki-4340-n1"></a>

- Beam effects persist until destroyed, use Last Created Entity handles, and fail when entity capacity is exhausted.

<a id="wiki-4340-n2"></a>

- A player supplied as endpoint follows the player; otherwise the endpoint is a world position.

<a id="wiki-4340-n3"></a>

- Only good/bad beam types accept color; team colors depend on hostility to the viewer and do not apply to sounds.
